The search points to **1998**: one source says Geelani took over the APHC chairmanship from Mirwaiz Umar Farooq that year, and Umar Farooq's profile gives his tenure as 1993–1998. However, the same results also say Geelani was replaced by Abdul Ghani Bhat in July 2000, so the sources conflict on his tenure, and I didn't check the Wikipedia pages directly.
CONFIDENCE: 60
